stored-first.label: Just-stored potion before a useless scroll
stored-first.explanation: Original: step 4 and step 5 both skip the potion because it was just stored; step 5 leaves its skip flag set, so it also skips the Scroll of Light, no step sets a goal and the scroll stays at home. Corrected: the flag is cleared for the scroll, removing it leaves the home power unchanged (1514), so step 5 picks home slot 1 and the real retrieve moves the Scroll of Light into the pack.

stored-last.label: Control: just-stored shovel after the scroll
stored-last.explanation: The just-stored item comes after the scroll, so the scroll is evaluated before the flag is ever set. Both versions take the Scroll of Light (home slot 0) and skip the shovel; the logs are identical.
